threadDescriptions.shopkeeper-testimony: Research former Market Street shops through oral testimony
threadDescriptions.map-rights: Obtain permission to reproduce the historical Market Street plan
threadDescriptions.walking-booklet: Write and lay out the Market Street history walking booklet
threadDescriptions.radio-repair: Repair my tabletop radio's tuning control
threadDescriptions.archive-deposit: Prepare the shopkeeper interviews for deposit in the town archive

items.text: Market Street interview notebook: Bea remembers the shoe repair shop at number 14. Ask where deliveries entered and who shared the yard.
items.rationale: Collects and extends testimony about the former shops.

items.text: Tabletop radio tuning knob slips on its shaft. The grub screw turns but never tightens; inspect the brass insert before replacing the whole knob.
items.rationale: Personal radio hardware diagnosis.

items.text: Walking booklet route begins at the old market arch, loops through Market Street, and ends at the pump. Aim for an easy 35-minute walk with six stops.
items.rationale: Defines the heritage booklet route and scope.

items.text: Museum owns the Market Street plan scan. Ask whether a 300-copy booklet run is allowed and what exact credit line they require.
items.rationale: Requests rights for reproducing a specific map.

items.text: Town archive deposit checklist for shopkeeper recordings: WAV files, transcripts, speaker release forms and a contents list. Keep restricted interviews in a clearly marked folder.
items.rationale: Defines the archival handoff package.

items.text: Bea corrects her earlier address: the shoe repair shop was 41 Market Street, not 14. Her father's invoice has the address; photograph it with her permission as supporting evidence.
items.rationale: Explicitly revises the remembered shop location with evidence.

items.text: Walking booklet stop 3: describe the shared yard before the shopfront. A visitor standing at the arch can still see the passage Bea described.
items.rationale: Writes reader-facing route content from established testimony.

items.text: They said yes to the small one only.
items.rationale: Unidentified permission and object cannot establish a task.

items.text: Museum permits the plan in the 300 printed booklets, with 'Town Collection, plan drawer 8' beneath it. This permission does not include posting the full scan online.
items.rationale: Records the map reproduction authorization and limitations.

items.text: Radio knob insert is stripped. A replacement insert grips properly; align the pointer at the dial's low end before tightening.
items.rationale: Repairs and aligns the tuning control.

items.text: Shopkeeper transcript review: Bea says the yard smelled of leather glue, while Omar remembers roasting coffee next door. Keep both accounts with their speakers instead of merging them into one recollection.
items.rationale: Preserves distinct oral-history accounts.

items.text: Archive intake found two recordings without speaker release forms. Hold those files out of the deposit until the signed forms arrive; the other four packages can proceed.
items.rationale: Resolves incomplete documentation in the archival submission.

items.text: Booklet map page: insert the museum's required credit exactly under the Market Street plan and note the 300-copy permission in the rights log. The PDF for public download should omit this plan because online reproduction was not granted.
items.rationale: Applies map-license conditions to two concrete publication versions and records compliance.

items.text: Rename my 'Old shops chats' folder to 'Market Street testimony'. The invoices and interview transcripts should stay grouped by speaker inside it.
items.rationale: Explicit rename and organization of the oral-history research.

items.text: Maybe drawer eight? Can't read the last word.
items.rationale: Tentative partial locator lacks enough evidence of a map or rights action.

items.text: Radio tracks stations smoothly across the dial now. Refit the back panel and keep the stripped insert to compare if it loosens again.
items.rationale: Verifies and closes the tuning repair.

items.text: Before depositing Bea's interview, append her correction from 14 to 41 to the transcript and catalogue summary. Keep the original spoken address in the recording and include the invoice photo as a supporting research attachment in her archive package.
items.rationale: Preserves a research correction and implements it in the archive handoff.

items.text: Walked the booklet route in 38 minutes. The pump stop has no safe standing space for a group; put the final paragraph at the bench before the corner instead.
items.rationale: Field-tests and adjusts the published walking route.

items.text: Museum confirmed the credit proof is acceptable. Save that email with the signed plan reproduction permission, not just the printer's messages.
items.rationale: Closes rights-credit verification with the rights holder.

items.text: Town archive receipt lists four complete shopkeeper packages and two withheld. Their catalogue numbers match the contents list; retain the receipt alongside the release forms.
items.rationale: Confirms precisely which materials were deposited.

undo.reason: Hypothetical correction: Bea's passage is used in booklet prose; this source neither collects nor corrects testimony.
